Union of the postfixed substates in U yields its greatest fixed substate; an independently nonempty outside postfixed witness makes that fixed substate populated. Thus a non-deletion criterion for the cone among relevant fixed substates excludes a rootless cone under the explicit guards, without global well-foundedness, receipt exclusivity or a quantitative measure. The targeted cone-intersection criterion is weaker than whole-configuration uniqueness. An unconditional outside root plus an acyclic infinite chain admits the fixed states {s} and the full order, so global nonemptiness and root existence do not guarantee CCR. A nonmonotone finite control shows why the restricted fixed-point existence assumption matters. Exhaustive Python diagnostic over 74088 eligible three-node operator/relation pairs checked 15317 cone cases and 450 with a populated outside postfixed witness. Structural controls only; no modal world or real production certified. Strongest surviving denial offers a bearerless necessary or primitive global constitutive fact with independent existential import; an underived concrete whole supplying its parts concedes the relative root. Existing root/common-source and necessity/uniqueness connections are mapped with their separate premises. Prior conditional modest preference and unrestricted underdetermination are retained, no change to reviewed current assessments or formal closure. Evidence is draft research, not a registered result. Continuation from c24c3d173, section “Can an individual act be identified without first identifying its recipient?”: two independently coordinated performances and a mixed recording separate identifying one concrete exercise by provenance from explaining its occurrence. The playing constitutes the performance without a performance already actual to receive it, while its players supply actuality. This gives content to the subsistent-act proposal without furnishing an instance of underived esse. A differentiated primary whole meets the same recipient test. Reaching either existence target still requires existentially adequate content for this very individual. The existing reviewed warrant assessments stand.
